title: Periventricular gradient pathology is linked to ependymal reactivity and cell adhesion disruption in multiple sclerosis
title_zh: 脑室周围梯度病理与室旁反应性与细胞粘附破坏在多发性硬化症中的关联
abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)-adjacent brain areas are especially vulnerable to diffuse degeneration in multiple sclerosis (MS). Surface-in gradients arising from CSF-borne cytotoxic factors have been proposed to predict disease relapses independent of white matter lesions. Yet, whether such factors disrupt ependymal cells to penetrate the ventricular border in MS remains unknown. Here, using ultra-high-field magnetic resonance imaging-guided histology, electron microscopy and single-nucleus multiomics, we found that ependymal pathology correlates with periventricular gradients and involves an immune-reactive state marked by transporter and junctional protein dysregulation. We further defined the gene regulatory networks underpinning the MS ependymal state and predicted ligands known to be enriched in MS CSF that could drive the emergence of this state. One of the candidates, IFNγ, increased murine ependymal permeability in vivo, indicating that CSF ligands can modulate ependymal function and regional inflammation. These findings identify CSF-driven ependymal dysfunction as a contributor to periventricular pathology in MS. This study identifies ependymal dysfunction as a mechanism linking inflammatory cerebrospinal fluid to increased ventricular permeability and periventricular pathology in multiple sclerosis.
abstract_zh: 脑脊液（CSF）相邻的脑区在多发性硬化症（MS）中特别容易出现弥散性退行性变。人们提出，源于CSF携带的细胞毒因子的表面梯度可以预测独立于白质病灶的疾病复发。然而，这些因子是否通过破坏室旁上皮细胞以穿过脑室边界仍然未知。在此，我们利用超高场磁共振成像引导组学、电子显微镜和单核多组学，发现室旁上皮病理变化与脑室周围梯度相关，并涉及一种以转运蛋白和连接蛋白功能障碍为特征的免疫反应状态。我们进一步阐明了MS室旁上皮状态背后的基因调控网络，并预测了已知在MS CSF中富集的配体，这些配体可能驱动该状态的出现。其中一种候选物，干扰素-γ，在 vivo 增加小鼠室旁上皮的通透性，表明CSF配体可以调节室旁上皮功能和区域性炎症。这些发现确定了CSF驱动的室旁上皮功能障碍是MS脑室周围病理的贡献因素。本研究确定了室旁上皮功能障碍作为连接炎症性脑脊液与脑室通透性增加和脑室周围病理的机制。
